
<!-- STUFFED DOG DIGITAL: HIGHLIGHTED PROJECTS (Elementor HTML widget)
     Paste into ONE Elementor HTML widget. Full-width layout recommended.
     Self-contained: every style is scoped under .sddfp, nothing here can
     touch other sections. Images are embedded, no media uploads needed.
     Fonts: expects Bricolage Grotesque + Manrope. If the page does not
     already load them, uncomment the link tag below. -->
<!-- <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Bricolage+Grotesque:opsz,wght@12..96,600;12..96,700;12..96,800&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"> -->
<style>
.sddfp { background: #111111; color: #FAF8F4; padding: clamp(72px, 10vw, 136px) clamp(20px, 5vw, 64px); border-top: 4px solid #F15A29; }
.sddfp .sddfp-inner { max-width: 1152px; margin: 0 auto; }
.sddfp .sddfp-eyebrow { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.28em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #F15A29; margin: 0 0 14px; }
.sddfp h2.sddfp-title { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(32px, 5.5vw, 68px); line-height: 0.98; letter-spacing: -0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #FAF8F4; margin: 0 0 24px; }
.sddfp .sddfp-lede { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.65; max-width: 34em; color: #FAF8F4; margin: 0 0 clamp(40px, 6vw, 72px); }
.sddfp .sddfp-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 7fr 5fr; gap: clamp(24px, 4vw, 56px); align-items: center; padding: clamp(36px, 5vw, 60px) 0; border-top: 1px solid #2A2A2A; }
.sddfp .sddfp-row.sddfp-flip { grid-template-columns: 5fr 7fr; }
.sddfp .sddfp-row.sddfp-flip .sddfp-media { order: 2; }
.sddfp .sddfp-media { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.sddfp .sddfp-video { aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; background: #000; border: 1px solid #2A2A2A; }
.sddfp .sddfp-video iframe { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; }
.sddfp .sddfp-media img { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
.sddfp .sddfp-site { border: 1px solid #2A2A2A; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
.sddfp .sddfp-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 10px 14px; background: #1E1E1E; border-bottom: 1px solid #2A2A2A; }
.sddfp .sddfp-dots span { display: inline-block; width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3A3A3A; margin-right: 5px; }
.sddfp .sddfp-url { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; color: #9B968D; background: #141414; border-radius: 16px; padding: 5px 14px; }
.sddfp .sddfp-sitebody { aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.sddfp .sddfp-sitebody img { width: 46%; height: auto; }
.sddfp .sddfp-gallery { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; }
.sddfp .sddfp-gallery img { border: 1px solid #2A2A2A; }
.sddfp .sddfp-info .sddfp-eyebrow { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.sddfp h3.sddfp-h { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(22px, 2.6vw, 32px); line-height: 1.05; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #FAF8F4; margin: 0 0 16px; }
.sddfp .sddfp-p { font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; max-width: 30em; color: #FAF8F4; margin: 0 0 20px; }
.sddfp .sddfp-link { font-family: 'Bricolage Grotesque', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; color: #FAF8F4; border-bottom: 2px solid #F15A29; padding-bottom: 4px; }
.sddfp .sddfp-link:hover { background: #F15A29; color: #1B1B1B; }
.sddfp .sddfp-row.sddfp-wide { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
.sddfp .sddfp-row.sddfp-wide .sddfp-media { order: 0; }
@media (max-width: 860px) {
  .sddfp .sddfp-row, .sddfp .sddfp-row.sddfp-flip { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .sddfp .sddfp-row.sddfp-flip .sddfp-media { order: 0; }
}
</style>
